author: Kt 0102 G
title: Bit disappointed with fund transfer time
review_text: Transferring money from bank account used to be so quick in the past. But nowadays, it takes about 2/3 minutes to have the money transferred unlike IMEpay which only takes few seconds. Otherwise, I love Esewa. I have been using it for more than 2 years now. Everything has become so easier because of Esewa. Thanks to the Esewa team.

author: priyanka thakali
title: Addressing a problem is really hard
review_text: The service is too slow and when we address a problem it takes months to get solved and I have to explain my problem everyday to new service providers of esewa this is ridiculous.you need to improve on you services and money management issues
